## 2d8e81383796

**Reproduced defect: advertised exact controls are not honored or observable.** Generator SHA-256 `b2947d4c4f848da595b347455615cbcdaea01c79a263a2dc931a8f7493241d4d` fails the official override contract with 7,077 findings across 79,470 draws and 883 cases. The minimized findings include inert `palette_kind`, `palette_size`, and `n_distinct_colors` axes; height/width mismatches under declared degenerates; missing provenance/observer support; and acceptance of the unknown key `__override_contract_unknown_axis__`. There are also 39,060 undeclared multi-axis rejections accepted only under the legacy compatibility policy.

Evidence: `checks/audit-2d8e81383796-override/checks/2d8e81383796_before_override.log` and its machine-readable result files. A direct seed-17/sample-23 probe also produced identical grids for `palette_kind=warm` versus `cool`, `palette_size=2` versus `5`, and `n_distinct_colors=2` versus `5`. No files for this audit target were changed.
